decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins are a visible product line with their own page and support the firm's core data integration business, so they are likely to be maintained.
The building digital twin service matches market trends and the firm's strategy, but it is less prominently presented, so it carries a moderate risk of being dropped.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service and could be merged into it, but it is cheap to maintain and useful for integration.
The open GIS application development framework is core to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and underpins its customer projects.
The identity service was actively promoted and supports the firm's goal of integrating with broader enterprise systems.
The consulting workshop is low cost, builds on the firm's consulting expertise, and has its own web page, so it is likely to be kept.
